content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: `missing` — no insurance clause anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Confirmed absence: the section outline has no insurance heading; the only "insurance" hit is an unrelated deduction in the revenue definition (p0012); Section 13 (Shared Resources) and Section 14 (Miscellaneous) contain no coverage obligation.
- Direction check: Corio (our party) is the licensee/hosting customer; Commerce One is the vendor supplying the Software, MarketSite service, and operations/consulting/engineering personnel who work with Corio's hosted environment and data — so the rule applies to it, not to us.
- Remedy: inserted a new §14.11 Insurance after §14.9 (before the execution language) at the preferred levels — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where our or our Customers' data is processed, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request — with the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback offered in the comment. Redline validated `ok:true` against precedent `seed-insurance`.
